summary: Tested P0 features: RulesPage refactored components and LevelUpModal. Fixed critical bug in VariosSection.jsx where API data structure didn't match component expectations. All 5 refactored rule sections (Sombra, Combate, Salarios, Varios, Viaje) now work correctly. LevelUpButton and LevelUpModal function properly with HP gain, proficiency bonus display, and occupation data loading.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: VariosSection.jsx had data structure mismatch - component expected 'efecto' but API returns 'consecuencia' for cansancio.niveles
FIXED: VariosSection.jsx expected ventaja.ventaja/desventaja strings but API returns ventaja.reglas array
FIXED: VariosSection.jsx expected inspiracion.como_obtener/como_usar as strings but API returns arrays
FIXED: VariosSection.jsx expected ojo_de_mordor fields as strings but API returns arrays/objects
All refactored rule components now properly handle the actual API data structure
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 features fully tested: 1) RulesPage refactored components (SombraSection, CombateSection, SalariosSection, VariosSection, ViajeSection) all work correctly. 2) LevelUpButton appears on character sheet next to level. 3) LevelUpModal opens and shows HP gain, proficiency bonus changes. 4) Modal correctly skips virtue selection at level 2 (virtues available at levels 4, 6, 8 for Buscador de tesoros). 5) Occupation virtudes_texto data is loaded from database.
